docs.title: Hey, I'm Alistair
docs.text:
I'm the Co-Founder & Co-CEO at Grw AI, where we're building AI that coaches salespeople (not replaces them).

Before Grw, I completed my Masters in Machine Learning at Cambridge, where I trained LLM agents through self-play to negotiate and persuade. Prior to that, I built two software companies.

When I'm not working, you'll find me traveling, surfing, climbing, or doing something that gets the adrenaline going.

docs.title: What I'm Building
docs.text: I'm the Co-Founder & Co-CEO at Grw AI. We're building AI that coaches salespeople, helping them get better at their craft without replacing the human element that makes great sales happen.

docs.title: Background
docs.text:
I completed my Masters in Machine Learning at the University of Cambridge, where my research focused on training LLM agents through self-play to develop negotiation and persuasion capabilities.

Before diving into AI research, I built two software companies from the ground up, giving me a unique perspective on both the technical and business sides of building products.

docs.title: Beyond Work
docs.text:
I'm passionate about:

  • Traveling - exploring new places and cultures
  • Surfing - chasing waves whenever I can
  • Climbing - both indoor and outdoor
  • Adrenaline sports - anything that gets the heart racing

docs.title: Connect With Me
docs.text:

docs.title: Hello World
docs.text: Welcome to my new blog. I'm excited to finally have a place to share my thoughts on AI engineering, company building, and the lessons I'm learning along the way.

docs.title: What to Expect
docs.text:
I'll be writing about:

  • AI Engineering: Technical deep-dives into building with LLMs, agent architectures, and the practical challenges of shipping AI products
  • Company Building: Lessons from building Grw AI and my previous ventures
  • Personal: Reflections on life, travel, and the pursuit of interesting experiences
  • Learnings: Books, ideas, and frameworks that have shaped my thinking

docs.title: Why Write?
docs.text:
Writing forces clarity of thought. It's easy to have vague ideas floating around, but putting them into words requires precision. I'm hoping this practice will sharpen my thinking while creating something useful for others.

Stay tuned for more.
